item.title: 1970 Ford Mustang Boss 302 4-Speed
item.description: This 1970 Ford Mustang Boss 302 was originally specified with Lime Metallic paintwork, a shaker hood scoop, sport slats, a rear spoiler, 15" Magnum 500 wheels, and a 302ci V8 paired with a four-speed manual transmission. The black interior features bucket seats, an AM radio, and a console with a Hurst shifter. item.title: Hellephant-Powered 2021 Jeep Gladiator Rubicon AMW 1000 at No Reserve
item.description: This 2021 Jeep Gladiator was modified in 2021–2022 by America’s Most Wanted 4×4 of Holly, Michigan, with their AMW 1000 conversion package, which includes a supercharged 6.2-liter SRT Hellephant V8 crate engine, an 8HP95 eight-speed automatic transmission, and the AMW 8LUG package with Dana 60 front and Dana 80 axles with ARB Air Lockers and 4.88:1 gearing. item.title: 33k-Mile 1994 Mazda RX-7 5-Speed
item.description: This 1994 Mazda RX-7 was purchased by the current owner in 2003 and has 33k miles following registration history in South Carolina. Powered by a twin-turbocharged 1.3-liter Wankel rotary engine linked to a five-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential, it is finished in Montego Blue Mica over tan leather upholstery. item.title: 1968 Porsche 912 Coupe 5-Speed
item.description: This 1968 Porsche 912 coupe is finished in Tangerine over black leatherette and is powered by a 1.6-liter flat-four mated to a five-speed manual transaxle. Equipment includes 15" Fuchs forged alloy wheels, disc brakes, quad exhaust outlets, bucket seats, and lap and shoulder belts. The current owner purchased the car in 2019, and the transaxle was refreshed in 2024. item.title: 2,800-Mile 1992 Dodge Viper RT/10
item.description: This 1992 Dodge Viper RT/10 is one of 285 produced for the model year, all of which were finished in Viper Red over gray leather. It shows 2,800 miles following registration history in Florida, Arizona, and Texas, and it was purchased by the seller in July 2019. item.title: 1964 Lincoln Continental Sedan
item.description: This 1964 Lincoln Continental is a black-on-red sedan that spent more than two decades with its prior owner before being acquired by the current owner on BaT in July 2022. Power is provided by a 430ci V8 linked with a three-speed automatic transmission, and the car is equipped with power steering, power-assisted brakes, 15" steel wheels, and polished wheel covers. item.title: 1985 Porsche 911 Carrera Coupe M491
item.description: This 1985 Porsche 911 Carrera coupe was specified with the M491 “Turbo Look” package and is powered by a 3.2-liter flat-six linked with a 915 five-speed manual transaxle. It is finished in black over black leather and has a sunroof, a Fabspeed muffler, and 16” BBS wheels as well as a MOMO steering wheel, a Blaupunkt CD stereo, cruise control, air conditioning, and power-adjustable front seats. item.title: 1968 Dodge Charger R/T
item.description: This 1968 Dodge Charger R/T was acquired out of Oregon from its original owner by the seller in 2016 as a project. A subsequent refurbishment was conducted between 2022 and 2025 with work that involved repainting the car in white, replacing the black vinyl roof, retrimming the black vinyl seats, and rebuilding the 440ci V8. item.title: 1967 Ferrari 330 GTC
item.description: This 1967 Ferrari 330 GTC is one of approximately 600 examples produced and was completed in May 1967 before being delivered new by Ferrari dealer M. Gastone Crepaldi S.a.s in Milan, Italy. Chassis 9945 was imported to the US in 1974 and later spent time in the UK and Switzerland before returning to the US in the late 1980s.
